chunks: You will see how they will lie against themselves, and all their slanderings will be vain.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people lie against themselves in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the psychological and spiritual self-destruction of the disbelievers who attribute false qualities to God, noting that their fabricated narratives collapse under the weight of divine truth. It serves as a warning that the 'lies' they told against their own souls—such as denying accountability or inventing partners for Allah—will vanish when they confront the reality of the Hereafter. This highlights the concept of *dhulm* (self-injustice) where one's own intellect and claims become the source of their ruin.
